subject: Re: ClearPay onboarding: PO fields, billing lane & early-remit proposal
messages:
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@clearpay.io>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@clearpay.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearPay onboarding: required PO fields + billing lane question

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. To keep the vendor onboarding moving, I'm attaching our completed onboarding form and a blank PO template so your AP team can validate field mappings on your end. A couple of items we need confirmation on before our first invoice goes out:

- Preferred remit-to vs. remit-by email for electronic invoices (we can use ACH/virtual card).
- Your active PO number format (we've seen both redwood-PO-##### and PO-YYYY-#### in your system).
- Billing cadence default (do you pay Net30, Net45, or Net60?).

Also: our finance team is requesting the ability to submit an early-pay request for our first three invoices (we typically ask for early remit for onboarding months). We'd like to offer a 1.0% discount if you can commit to payment within 10 days (remit-at-10) for those invoices. Is that feasible on your side?

Attachments: ClearPay_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (spreadsheet), ClearPay_PO_Template.csv (csv)

Appreciate any guidance so we can map fields correctly.

Best,
Jordan Smith
Head of Finance Operations
ClearPay Solutions
[jordan.smith@clearpay.io]

On Tue, Mar 20, 2028 at 12:05 PM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for sending this over — forward for AP review.

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@clearpay.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearPay onboarding: required PO fields + billing lane question

Jordan,

Thanks for the forms — received and reviewed briefly. A few quick notes from our side:

- Remit routing: AP prefers an ACH remit-to bank account (we accept virtual card as well). Please include a remit-to bank account name + routing + account last 4 in the onboarding sheet; our PO intake will surface the remit type.
- PO format: we can accept either redwood-PO-##### or PO-YYYY-#### — we will normalize to PO-YYYY-#### in the backend when creating the invoice lane. If you can populate the PO as your system issues it, that reduces reconciliation friction.
- Billing cadence: our default target is Net30. We occasionally support Net45 for enterprise contracts but that requires Legal + Finance sign-off.

Regarding early payment: we can do an early-pay program via our AP portal but need to be consistent with our economics. For pilot onboarding invoices, I can propose the following to Finance: net30 as the baseline and allow an early-remit at 10 days with a fee of 0.75% (we typically absorb half of what external early-pay providers charge). If ClearPay is offering 1.0% discount, that makes sense — I'd like to confirm whether your 1.0% is applied off gross invoiced amount and whether it will be shown on the invoice lines.

Next steps: Karthik / David — can you validate that we can accept the attached CSV mapping as-is and confirm whether PO-YYYY normalization is OK? If AP needs a separate vendor record for virtual card, flag that too.

Jordan — can you send a W-9 and the remit account authorization? If you prefer DocuSign for the authorization, include the link and we will route accordingly.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

[Attachment: ClearPay_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ClearPay PO mapping + early-pay ask (quick)

Karthik / David —

Looping you both here for a quick thumbs-up. Key asks from vendor: accept Net30 (we prefer), allow an early-remit pilot (10-day remit for first 3 invoices) with a 0.75% fee (we would absorb this cost).

Specifics to validate:
- Can the intake form accommodate both the PO formats and normalize to PO-YYYY-####?
- Do we need a separate virtual-card vendor record or can we store remit preferences in the same vendor profile?
- Any reason Finance/Legal would object to a 10-day early-remit pilot for onboarding?

If this is green, I will reply to Jordan with confirmation and request W-9 + signed remit auth.

—Aditya

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: ClearPay PO mapping + early-pay ask (quick)

Aditya —

We can normalize both formats during intake; the PO-YYYY-#### will be the canonical key in the ledger. No blocker there.

On virtual card: create a single vendor record but add a payment method table to hold multiple options (ACH, virtual_card). That keeps vendor profile compact and supports different remit lanes. Our team can map the ClearPay_PO_Template.csv to the intake fields with minor tweaks — I'll mark the three fields that need renaming (remit_type -> payment_method, acct_last4 -> account_last4, tax_id -> vendor_tax_id).

Early-pay: Finance historically approves short pilot programs for onboarding. If we cap the liability to the first three invoices and require invoice-level acceptance in the AP portal (not auto-apply), Legal wants a short addendum stating the early-pay fee (0.75%) and that discount/fee will be reflected on the invoice. I can draft that addendum.

Green to proceed pending W-9 and remit authorization.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@clearpay.io>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@clearpay.io>, accounts@clearpay.io
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearPay onboarding: PO fields, billing lane & early-remit proposal

Aditya / Karthik —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the proposed approach. ClearPay accepts the PO-YYYY-#### normalization plan and will populate the PO field in our invoices exactly as issued so your mapping should pick it up.

We have attached the completed W-9 and a signed remit authorization (PDF) for ACH. Attaching the onboarding form as a final copy. Please confirm receipt.

Regarding early-pay: we accept the 0.75% fee you proposed (applied as a reduction to our requested early payment amount) and agree to the pilot constraints (first three invoices, invoice-level opt-in). I see Karthik will prepare a short addendum — happy to sign via DocuSign.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/link/ABCD-1234-efgh

Next steps for Redwood AP: confirm vendor ID creation, let us know if you need a separate remit lane enabled for virtual card, and confirm when the first invoice should be routed (we plan to submit it the week of Apr 2).

Attachments: ClearPay_W9.pdf, ClearPay_Remittance_Authorization.pdf

Best,
Jordan Smith
Head of Finance Operations
ClearPay Solutions
[jordan.smith@clearpay.io]
